full_details: At nine the morning was the Queen's farewell at the Tower gate. You had written weep here in Nick's roll. He would not weep before the scene gave him cause, and on Thursday the cause had come three lines later. Your explanation failed halfway, when it left the page. Augustine had him give it plain. It was less to look at and more to believe. Richard, waiting on his cue, forgot to fidget. You struck the direction out with the point of a paring-knife, and you changed the instruction, not the boy. On your tables you wrote that a direction is a guess, and that N. S. knew better. The jaw made every consonant a negotiation. In the afternoon the king was played the second time. You were Gaunt, and you were done by the middle. The Rose had The New World's Tragedy. You heard the title and did not go. At night three candles went to the socket for the tooth. The lovers got none of them.
one_sentence: You let Nick give the farewell plain, played Gaunt a second time, and walked the tooth through three candles.
title: The margin struck out, and three candles
